dedupe_keys.name: movsim multi model open source vehicular traffic simulator

description: MovSim is a microscopic, lane-based road traffic simulator with XML configuration and CSV text output. It implements several car-following models from the textbook Traffic Flow Dynamics, including the Intelligent Driver Model, the enhanced IDM or adaptive cruise control model and the optimal velocity model, and models lane changes with the MOBIL strategy; it simulates multi-lane roads with on-ramps, off-ramps, bottlenecks and traffic lights, and includes a physics-based fuel consumption model. It is written by Arne Kesting, Martin Treiber, Ralph Germ and Martin Budden. It is generic and applies to road sections and small networks anywhere. It runs from the command line or a graphical viewer, needs Java 7 or later and is built with Maven; the code is free on GitHub under GPL version 3, with commercial use by arrangement with the copyright holders. Caveats: the copyright notice covers 2010 to 2016, so development may have slowed, and it models road sections, not city-wide networks. MovSim supports capacity studies of motorway bottlenecks and ramps, testing of traffic flow models and fuel use estimates. It complements the SUMO simulator catalogued here.
